C1172.title: API Logic Flaw in Domestic E-Commerce Platform Exposes 1.18 Billion Order Records
C1172.summary: In June 2021, a domestic e-commerce platform suffered a data leak of 1.18 billion user order records due to a logic flaw in the combination of two API interfaces. Attackers exploited this vulnerability to gain unauthorized access to data through legitimate API calls, representing a typical case of API business logic abuse.

references.title: Massive Data Leak of Tens of Millions Caused by API Logic Flaw - Zhihu
